description: Compute Ca2+ and Zn2+ coordination spheres and per-residue B-factors in the isolated CHAPk domain crystal structure 4CSH
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

txt = requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/4CSH.pdb", timeout=90).text

atoms=[]
for ln in txt.splitlines():
    if ln.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
        atoms.append(dict(rec=ln[:6].strip(), name=ln[12:16].strip(), resn=ln[17:20].strip(),
                          ch=ln[21], resi=ln[22:26].strip(), x=float(ln[30:38]), y=float(ln[38:46]),
                          z=float(ln[46:54]), b=float(ln[60:66]), el=ln[76:78].strip()))
A=pd.DataFrame(atoms)
xyz=A[["x","y","z"]].values

def shell(sel_resn, cutoff):
    out=[]
    for i,row in A[A.resn==sel_resn].iterrows():
        d=np.linalg.norm(xyz-np.array([row.x,row.y,row.z]),axis=1)
        near=A[(d<cutoff)&(d>0.1)&(A.resn!=sel_resn)]
        dn=d[(d<cutoff)&(d>0.1)&(A.resn!=sel_resn).values]
        for (j,n),dd in zip(near.iterrows(),dn):
            out.append(dict(metal=sel_resn, metal_chain=row.ch, ligand="%s%s.%s"%(n.resn,n.resi,n.ch),
                            atom=n["name"], dist=round(dd,2), is_water=(n.resn=="HOH")))
    return pd.DataFrame(out)

ca=shell("CA",3.0); zn=shell("ZN",2.8)
print("=== 4CSH Ca2+ coordination (<3.0 A), protein ligands only ===")
cap = ca[~ca.is_water].sort_values(["metal_chain","dist"])
print(cap.to_string(index=False))
print("\nCa2+ per chain: protein ligands=%d, waters=%d (total across 4 chains)" %
      ((~ca.is_water).sum(), ca.is_water.sum()))

print("\n=== 4CSH Zn2+ coordination (<2.8 A), protein ligands only ===")
znp = zn[~zn.is_water].sort_values(["metal_chain","dist"])
print(znp.to_string(index=False))
print("\nZn2+ per chain: protein ligands=%d, waters=%d" % ((~zn.is_water).sum(), zn.is_water.sum()))

# distinct coordinating residues
print("\nDistinct Ca-coordinating residues (any chain):", sorted(set(cap.ligand.str.split(".").str[0])))
print("Distinct Zn-coordinating residues (any chain):", sorted(set(znp.ligand.str.split(".").str[0])))

# --- B-factor profile per residue, chain A: is the 1-165 construct ordered to its C-terminus?
prot=A[(A.rec=="ATOM")&(A.ch=="A")]
prof=prot.groupby(prot.resi.astype(int)).b.mean()
modelled=set(prof.index)
print("\nChain A modelled residue range: %d-%d ; missing within range: %s" %
      (min(modelled), max(modelled), sorted(set(range(min(modelled),max(modelled)+1))-modelled)))
print("Mean B chain A = %.1f ; mean B of last 10 modelled residues = %.1f" %
      (prof.mean(), prof.loc[sorted(modelled)[-10:]].mean()))
print("Mean B of catalytic triad C54/H117/E134 = %.1f" %
      prof.loc[[r for r in (54,117,134) if r in modelled]].mean())

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.4))
ax=axes[0]
ax.plot(prof.index, prof.values, lw=1.2, color="#2b6cb0")
for r,c,lab in [(54,"#c53030","Cys54"),(117,"#c53030","His117"),(134,"#c53030","Glu134")]:
    if r in prof.index: ax.axvline(r, color=c, ls=":", lw=1); ax.text(r, prof.max()*0.97, lab, rotation=90, fontsize=7, va="top", color=c)
for r in sorted(set(cap[cap.metal_chain=="A"].ligand.str.extract(r"(\d+)")[0].astype(int))):
    ax.plot(r, prof.get(r, np.nan), "o", ms=6, color="#2f855a")
ax.set_xlabel("Residue (UniProt Q6Y7T6 numbering)"); ax.set_ylabel("Mean B-factor (A^2)")
ax.set_title("4CSH chain A: CHAPk 1-165 is ordered end to end\n(green = Ca2+ ligands)", fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1]
cats=["Ca2+ protein\nligands","Ca2+ waters","Zn2+ protein\nligands","Zn2+ waters"]
vals=[(~ca.is_water).sum()/4,(ca.is_water).sum()/4,(~zn.is_water).sum()/4,(zn.is_water).sum()/4]
ax.bar(cats, vals, color=["#2f855a","#9ae6b4","#2b6cb0","#90cdf4"])
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i, v+0.05, "%.2f"%v, ha="center", fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("Coordinating atoms per metal site")
ax.set_title("Metal coordination in the isolated CHAP domain\n(4CSH, 1.79 A, averaged over 4 chains)", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

ca.to_csv("lysK_CHAPk_4CSH_Ca_coordination.csv", index=False)
zn.to_csv("lysK_CHAPk_4CSH_Zn_coordination.csv", index=False)
print("\nSaved: lysK_CHAPk_4CSH_Ca_coordination.csv, lysK_CHAPk_4CSH_Zn_coordination.csv")
